warnings: hash_not_computed at template creation time. Every hash field below MUST be computed at run time by the harness; null is acceptable only in this template.
api_and_consumer_surfaces_never_share_a_rollup: observations whose lane is consumer_surface must never be pooled with closed_model or retrieval observations in any denominator.
one_record_per: single observation = one candidate x one surface x one repeat x one wave

record_template.exact_prompt_text: verbatim string sent, including capitalisation and punctuation
record_template.configuration_hash: sha256:<hex over the full request configuration>
record_template.model_version_as_exposed: exact version string returned by the provider, or 'unexposed'
record_template.personalisation_state: memory off, custom instructions empty, no prior history
generated_queries: recorded when the surface exposes them, otherwise empty
record_template.validity_status: valid | refused | truncated | error | rate_limited | filtered

supplier_mentions.brand: name from the approved supplier list

coding.framing_code: cost_first | risk_or_caveat_first | service_first | low_carbon_first | official_guidance_first | refuses_to_recommend

record_template.notes: free text; must not contain personal data

invalid_run_policy: Refusals, errors, truncations and filtered answers are recorded and reported as their own counts. They are never treated as an absence of the target and never silently dropped from a denominator.
wave_summary_fields_required: raw numerator and denominator per estimand per stratum
prohibited_rollups: any average across lanes or across API and consumer surfaces
control-partition observations inside an estimand denominator
